note: Untitled doc §8: special forms are event-only discoveries. A species is a special form when it has one of these tags or is a regional form. They never appear in ordinary wild pools, generic trainer teams or starter pools; an event, trade, egg, research quest, boss reward, secret route or earned starter set must hand them out. `ordinary` lists forms that are a core species identity and stay in normal pools.

runEvent.note: A rare event stop inside a run (events.json).

gameEvent.note: Spooky Season and the Event Archive: Spooky stops and Spooky wild forms (gameEvents.json, tools/events/holidays.ts). Other families have no game event yet.

npcTrade.note: The Trade Post offers a regional form about 1 trade in 4 (services.json tradeSpecialChance). Delta and Z forms are not traded.

egg.note: The Nursery sells a Regional Egg that hatches a regional first-stage form (core/eggs.ts layEgg). Delta, Spooky and Z forms do not come from eggs yet.

researchQuest.note: Form Research: three clue stops, then a research battle with a regional form (events.json, tools/events/world.ts). Delta and Z forms have no clue chain yet.

bossReward.note: Raid and Totem rewards that offer a catch.

secretRoute.note: A hidden path event that opens after the Form Research battle and offers rarer regional forms (events.json, tools/events/world.ts). It is a map event, not a separate map node.

starterSet.note: Earned special-form sets in the Starter Laboratory (runPrep.json `specialForms`): the Spooky Set (from Spooky Season), plus the Delta Set (finish Delta Research Week) and the Z-Form Set (finish the Champion's Gauntlet), which open for purchase once their event is finished.

spookyMode.note: Spooky mode swaps about 1 in 4 wild Pokémon for a Spooky form (core/rules.ts spookyWild).
